standard_candidate_graph.precondition: Only valid catalog profile ids0..143, unmodified ordinary entry/purchase/checkout paths.
standard_candidate_graph.entry: Customer initialization0x800319ac assigns current product from profile+8, wallet from profile i16+6.
standard_candidate_graph.extras: Purchase0x800340fc when current product=-1 increments candidate index, reads profile+8+candidate among four slots, and terminates at candidate>=4.
standard_candidate_graph.fact: All144x4 catalog slots have no product26. In this scoped candidate graph cash dispenser is not selected as normal shopping destination.
standard_candidate_graph.exclusions: This is not a full-program all-writers/hidden-event proof. Invalid profile144 bypass context remains a separate issueR02.

destination.rule: Shelf accepted only if image->product matches wanted product and stock quantity>0. Category5 dispenser is an immediate class alongside categories2/3 and additionally requires cart0.
destination.implication: Mere presence of a dispenser does not route a customer wanting another product to it.

money.product: Cash id26 has base price0,cost percent100. With ordinary unit formula trunc(base*(factor+setting)/100), unit remains0.
money.generic_wallet: On successful item take, wallet16 is updated by subtraction of unit at0x80034b00..0x80034b04; no wallet credit is shown in this generic item path.
money.immediate_sales: Immediate class posts unit*quantity to daily revenue/company cash. For zero base unit this is0; it does not establish a withdrawal or fee. This is algebraic behavior conditional on forcing that product into path, not proof of natural reachability.
money.inventory: Product stock procurement value is0. Source capacity50/90 is packed inventory quantity, not established50万/90万 withdrawal/bank balance.
money.price_score: Product26 is explicitly excluded from average-price score accumulator0x800240a8, so do not include its zero price in store cheapness average.

advice.scope: Own stores only; manager references assumed valid.
advice.gate: Rare RNG&0x1fff==0, then manager academic roll. Best usage count must>=200; odd choice can select least-used stocked product with count<6.
advice.cash_text: If least product id==26, append specific original text0x80099338 instead of generic product-name low-sales text.
advice.meaning: This proves a dispenser low-use notification branch exists; it does not itself dispense money, charge fees or make a shopper select26.
advice.reset: After rare branch, all27 usage counters+0x11a0+j*12 reset.

established: Cash/dispenser descriptors,layouts and visual stock identifiers
not_established: Naturally reached dedicated cash withdrawal path

port: Keep actual fixture/assets/maintenance and raw stock data; do not invent a cash reward,banking UI or fee. Preserve unresolved status and separate population/profile safety.
